scope.description: All NFL Week 10 regular-season games scheduled for Sunday, November 15, 2026

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 9
historical_cutoff.exclusion: No Week 10 game may enter the historical sample

percentile_methodology.definition: Calculate the 15th percentile using the 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the historical cutoff; standard linear interpolation. This is an explicit user-directed override to the uploaded V7.2.9 file's default 20-game P15 requirement.
